name: Stalwart Signup Manager
author: Bulkwart-register contributors
description: Review Stalwart mailbox signup requests and control manual or automatic approval from the Bulwark admin console.

serviceUrl.label: Signup service URL
serviceUrl.description: HTTPS origin of the companion service, for example https://signup.example.net. Do not include a path or trailing slash.

servicePath.label: Signup service path
servicePath.description: Optional path prefix when using an existing portal, for example /signup. Use / for the companion service at the origin root.

apiToken.label: Admin API token
apiToken.description: The ADMIN_API_TOKEN configured in the companion service. It is stored by Bulwark and injected by the server-side proxy.
